signature.name: Al-Balad
signature.detail: The historic old town is Jeddah's heart, a UNESCO-listed maze of coral-stone houses, carved wooden balconies and narrow lanes that show the city's Red Sea trading past. It is the one place every first-time visitor should walk. Go in the late afternoon or evening when the heat eases and the souq lanes come alive; wear modest clothing and expect plenty of walking.

signature.name: King Fahd's Fountain
signature.detail: This giant fountain shoots seawater high above the Red Sea and is Jeddah's best-known modern sight, especially dramatic after dark when it is lit. It is a quick, free stop rather than a long visit. Come at night for the best view from the Corniche; no tickets are needed.

transport: Taxis and ride-hailing are the main way around; short rides $5-10
